Subject: Kickoff: MAP & Executive Sponsor Intro — Redwood <> Aperture Health

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get alignment on scope, stakeholders, and timeline so both teams can move quickly toward a scoped pilot.

Quick context: Aperture is looking to evaluate real-time clinical note summarization and a semantic search prototype across ~200k documents. Our proposed pilot will validate latency/cost at 99th percentile and surface-level quality on 6 clinical templates.

Attached is a first-draft MAP (Aperture-MAP-draft-20260302.pdf) with milestone suggestions. High-level asks:
- Please confirm your exec sponsor and technical owner for procurement/scoping (VP/CTO level + lead engineer).
- Can you review the proposed milestones and accept/adjust timeline by EOD Wed (2026-03-04)?
- If procurement/legal needs a pre-call, loop them now so we can include required artifacts (SOC2, data handling notes).

For transparency on our side, I’d like to introduce two Redwood execs into the thread once you confirm sponsors: Maya Srinivasan (VP Product) will be our executive sponsor to align outcomes and quarterly metrics; Vivek Kulkarni (Head, Solutions & Escalations) will be the point for technical escalation and priority capacity commitments. I’ll only loop them once you confirm the Aperture exec sponsor.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm Aperture exec sponsor & technical owner (by 2026-03-04).
2) We agree on pilot success metrics and finalize MAP v1 (target sign-off 2026-03-11).
3) Kick pilot (target start 2026-04-01, 6-week run).

Happy to hop on a 30-min alignment call if helpful — I’m available Wed 10–12 PT or Thu afternoon.

Attachments: Aperture-MAP-draft-20260302.pdf

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Sean — thanks, looks good as a starting point. I’m happy to be the project sponsor on the product side, and I’m looping in Dinesh Rao, our CTO, who will own technical acceptance criteria and the pilot sign-off. Procurement is CC’d for transparency.

Dinesh — I’ll let you review the MAP draft and confirm the technical owner from your team. High-level expectations from my side:
- Pilot should demonstrate 95%+ template-level extract accuracy for the six templates we shared.
- 99th percentile latency < 350ms for 512-token prompts (we discussed SLO tradeoffs).
- Clear plan for PHI-handling and audit logging in scope.

I can meet for a kickoff 30-min sync Thu 11am ET if that works for Dinesh and the Redwood team.

Thanks,
